title_as_printed: Comparisons of the measured and calculated solubilities of oxygen in seawater and Dead Sea water diluted with water at 25 C.

footnotes_as_printed.b: Measured values for artificial Dead Sea water (Krumgalz and Millero, 1982).
footnotes_as_printed.c: The weight fraction of Dead Sea water diluted with water.

pressure_note: Solubilities in moist air were corrected to a total pressure of 1 atm from the measured atmospheric pressures (+-1 mbar); 'The measurements were made on solutions in equilibrium with the atmosphere saturated with water vapor.' Small correction for water vapour pressure being constant when correcting to 1 atm was neglected.
gas_basis_evidence: O2 from air; result is the dissolved O2 amount per kg H2O ('we report the solubilities in umol (kg H2O)-1 or molality (m)'), not a gas mole fraction
volume_basis_evidence: 'we report the solubilities in umol (kg H2O)-1 or molality (m)'; solutions were made by volume and converted to molality with density equations (Lo Surdo et al., 1982)
extra_unmapped: X (weight fraction of Dead Sea water; composition variable, no mapping slot)
conversion_needs: P is 1 atm total pressure of moist air, not O2 partial pressure; builder needs the O2 mole fraction in dry air and water vapour pressure if partial pressure is wanted
standard_conditions_note: Not applicable (no gas volumes); the paper does not define standard conditions.

value.what: measured O2 per kg H2O in artificial Dead Sea water diluted with water

composition.other_species: artificial Dead Sea water (sulfate-free) diluted with water; X = weight fraction of Dead Sea water (X=0 pure water, X=1 undiluted). Undiluted composition: Na+ 1.752 m, Mg2+ 1.555 m, Ca2+ 0.421 m, K+ 0.174 m, Cl- 5.810 m, HCO3- 0.0039 m, Br- 0.0602 m. Row-wise dilution fraction is in column X (not a molality).

notes: Only the Dead Sea (lower) block is written: it holds measured values. The Seawater block of Table 10 (S=0-40, 'Calculated' from Eqn. 9 vs model, in umol per kg solution) contains no measurements and is not extracted. The label row 'Dead Sea' is not written. 5 rows.
hold_table: artificial Dead Sea water diluted by weight fraction X: Br- (0.0602 m) and HCO3- (0.0039 m) are outside the six-ion set and the dilution is given as a weight fraction, not a molality (audit 2026-10-02)
